saw_lines: Job seekers don’t buy features. They buy the first employer reply, and they judge any tool by whether interviews actually follow.
So the sale is won or lost on the landing page, where a seeker decides if an AI promise feels real.
Your site shows 23 initial responses and 2 job offers, but your 4 live ads carry no number. Open the next batch with 23 responses on the creative, one per ad.
ads_1: Interview-first creative built on the 23 response count, with three new openers
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, X and Youtube
